span.normalized: Fanatics operates as Barnes & Noble Education’s service provider, including processing consumer personal information on its behalf, using their cutting-edge e-commerce and technology expertise to offer Barnes & Noble Education’s campus store websites expanded product selection, a world-class online and mobile experience, and a progressive direct-to-consumer platform. Coupled with Lids, the leading standalone brick and mortar retailer focused exclusively on licensed fan and alumni products, Barnes & Noble Education’s campus stores have improved access to trend and sales performance data on licensees, product styles, and design treatments.
